text: Decided by the brain after the last attempt (Athena's test check fell from about 12 to 7.8 minutes, the suite's run to about 405 s): keep that approach and its changes. Production changes are allowed when they leave behavior unchanged and each has a test proving it: the secret scanner's memo of results for identical text within one process (crates/athena-gate/src/secrets.rs) and the shorter poll schedule in run_check (crates/athena-core/src/checks.rs); both files are deliverables. The target is the full cargo test --locked under 7 minutes on the job's machine (measured, reported in docs/decisions.md with the per-binary before and after). Everything else from the earlier corrections stands (no test removed, weakened or filtered; nextest rejected with its measurement).
